page0: make a quick note app app where i can paste something in and its in a super clean file system i just want to make quick text notes and save them some nested folders nothing crazy but super simple sleek lux design glass floating panels so simply elegant
objective: A tiny fast note app for pasting/typing text into locally saved notes organized by simple nested folders, with a restrained glass-panel MOOR presentation.
decisions: Browser-local persistence only in v1 via localStorage; no fake claim of disk/cloud filesystem sync.
Three-pane desktop layout: folder tree, notes list, editor; collapses on smaller screens.
Nested folders support create, subfolder, rename, delete; deleted folder notes move to root.
Notes autosave while typing and support create/delete/search.
Use Environment Engine presentation tokens lightly for canonical MOOR visual continuity without adding animated visual clutter.
done_criteria: Text can be pasted/typed and survives reload in browser storage.
Nested folders can be created and navigated.
Notes can be created, edited, searched and deleted.
UI remains minimal, glassy and usable at desktop and narrow widths.
Pulse registers and preserves the app across rebuilds.
The sealed Funnel can replay Page 0 and issue a valid receipt for this blueprint.
honest_limits: v1 is device/browser localStorage, not OS-level filesystem access or cloud sync.
Deleting a folder moves contained notes to root rather than deleting them.
No rich text, collaboration, attachments or AI features in v1.
